segments.dry: Dry-skin cues are limited, but one reviewer reports the serum dried her skin out too much and stopped using it, contrasting with most who describe it as moisturizing.
segments.sensitive: Multiple reviewers identify as having sensitive skin or sensitive eyes and report no irritation, stinging, or redness, including one whose mother has very sensitive skin and also tolerated it well.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as mature or in their 50s report reduced visibility of fine lines and wrinkles and hydration benefits, though one mature-skin reviewer saw no difference and felt it did not suit her skin type.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines, crow's feet, sagging, or crepiness, often within one to two weeks; a few say lines persist or that deep wrinkles cannot be eliminated, and one long-term user needed a month to see fine lines disappear.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe the eye area as hydrated, plumped, or moisturized for hours after application; one reviewer reports the opposite, that it dried her skin out too much and she stopped using it.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with sensitive eyes or eczema report no irritation or redness after use, with no dissenting reports of redness found.
concerns.barrier: No reviewer specifically discusses barrier repair; hydration and comfort comments are the closest related feedback and are covered under dehydration.
concerns.spots: One reviewer credits the serum with fading dark circles and another reports it helping with dark spots around the eyes, though these are isolated mentions rather than a consistent pattern.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the serum is helping clear milia around the eyes; no other reviewer discusses blemishes in this area.
